call_points.text: No numeric FY27 guidance; management only says it expects stronger execution and improved financial performance in coming quarters.
Tender pipeline over ₹2 lakh crore, split equally between T&D and non-T&D.
Debt would have been lower but for delayed Afghanistan collections, expected in Q2, and higher strategic inventory.
Elastomeric cables production to start in Q2 FY27, E-Beam plant commissioning in Q3 FY27.
KEC Spur Infrastructure, a wholly owned subsidiary, is being merged into KEC International.
Headwinds named: Middle East geopolitical uncertainty, delayed project awards there, and payment delays in water projects.
Continued right-of-way issues in India T&D and delayed legal closure of Transportation and Metro claims.
Order book and L1 position stands at over ₹40,000 Cr, providing strong revenue visibility.
T&D revenue share increased to 68% in FY26 from 59% in FY25.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The VAT tribunal by its order dated November 20, 2024, received on December 01, 2024, by the Bangladesh Branch of the Company, dismissed the appeal against the VAT demand raised in the order dated April 29, 2024, for the alleged mismatch in financials and VAT return for the period July 2019 to June 2022. The appeal for July 2017 to June 2019 has been remanded back to VAT commissioner for re-verification of the order passed by the Commissioner. The Company has filed a review petition with Tribunal against the order passed for the period July 2019 to June 2022. The Tribunal has remanded the matter to the Commissioner for fresh adjudication within 120 days along with its judgment findings.
tax_litigation.status: During the quarter, the VAT Commissioner issued a notice seeking factual details for verification of the documents for period from July 2017 to June2022, pursuant to the Tribunal’s decision. The Company has submitted all the requisite details and documents to the VAT Commissioner. The Company will take all appropriate legal measures to defend its position, including challenging the order before the High Court of Bangladesh, as necessary.

timeline.summary: KEC International secured new orders worth ₹1,002 Cr across T&D, Renewables, Transportation, and Cables businesses.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹6,389.75 Cr (-7.0% YoY), net profit ₹192.79 Cr (-28.1% YoY).
KEC International approved the Scheme of Merger by Absorption of its wholly owned subsidiary KEC Spur Infrastructure Private Limited.
KEC International reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹23,506 crore and net profit of ₹606 crore, with order intake reaching ₹25,280 crore.
KEC International uploaded the audio recording of its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on May 18, 2026.
KEC International made available the transcript of its Q4FY26 earnings conference call.
KEC International submitted its investor presentation for the RPG Annual Investor Conference 2026.
KEC International secured new orders worth ₹1,303 crore across T&D, Civil, Renewables, and Cables businesses.

KEC International secured new orders worth ₹1,006 Cr across T&D, Civil, and Cables businesses.
KEC International secured ₹2,872 Cr turnkey orders from PGCIL for 765 kV transmission lines in Gujarat.
KEC International Ltd. will hold an Earnings Conference Call on Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on Tuesday, November 03, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. (IST).
